Name: Michmash
Description: A Benjaminite town, identified with Mukhmas in the West Bank, where the Philistines encamped against Israel and where Jonathan and his armor-bearer routed them, beginning a pursuit that carried the battle from Michmash to Aijalon. Isaiah later names Michmash on the Assyrian army's march toward Jerusalem, where it laid up its carriages.
BiblicalSignificance: Michmash is where a two-man act of trust in God turned into a rout of a far larger army, showing that the battle belongs to the Lord.
